messages:
Alex K.: Heads-up: seeing a latency spike on inference-router for region-us-east. Apdex dropped from 0.98 -> 0.65. I pushed a hotfix PR to revert the recent connpool change that correlates with the regression: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4587
Priya S.: ack. Any rollout plan? can we canary before full merge?
Alex K.: plan: merge -> auto-canary (10%) for 15m -> monitor traces/500s -> rollforward if good. Need approvals to unfreeze. Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z inference-router ERROR latency_ms=1234 route=generate model=gpt-small
2026-03-17T14:02:13Z connpool WARN dial timeout 200ms
```
Jamal R.: I'll take a quick pass now, pinging @Sasha L. for an extra pair if needed. Can you add a changelog line and a test to cover the connpool fallback?
Alex K.: added changelog, test in PR. The test is fragile but covers the timing window. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4587/files
Sasha L.: looking. if this is revert-only i'm ok with fast-track, but we should add a follow-up issue to rework fallback logic.
Morgan T.: FYI alert floods are hitting paging. can we mute the alert channel during canary? paging oncall if not.
Oncall Bot: Incident paging suppressed for 30m by Morgan T.
Jamal R.: left review comments, requested minor refactor.
Alex K.: addressed comments, pushed force-push. need one maintainer approval to merge.
Priya S.: @team-eng can someone with maintainer rights approve so we can start canary? :pray:
Dev Deploy Bot: Canary rollout started for pr-4587 (10%) at commit abc123. smoke test failed on one instance:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-us-east.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq '.error'
"timeout"
```
Alex K.: investigating smoke fail — looks like socket timeout under load. will revert canary if not green in 5m.
Sasha L.: +1 to revert if smoke doesn't stabilize. Jamal do you want to keep watching?
Jamal R.: watching metrics dashboard, will call if error rate > 1%.
Alex K.: merging now because last check looks stable, merging with maintainer override. merging at 14:08 UTC.
Dev Deploy Bot: pr-4587 merged by Alex K. Canary bumped to 50%.
Priya S.: thanks everyone. filing follow-up ticket for connpool proper fix. #postmortem-if-needed :thumbsup:
